title: PBA: Rain or Shine escapes Blackwater to clinch q'finals spot
summary: Rain or Shine is through to the quarterfinals of the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup after fending off Blackwater, 125-123, on Saturday at the Ynares Center in Antipolo.
